name: superdev
description: Superdev for Claude Code and Codex: 16 skills and 41 agents that build products on Navree, installed per project.

plugins.name: superdev
plugins.description: 16 skills and 41 agents that take a product from a PRD and a design to a released, verified Navree app: the Navree CLI and Navree's own skills first, a plan with acyclic module tiers and scaling/worker choices plus each module's contract and pass/reject stories on disk before code, one module at a time with runtime and browser proof, then a security review, an audit, a QA gate where every cell cites evidence, and deployment with Navree's tools. Screens in Navree UI or Next.js; optional Tauri clients.
